title: IG DM Setter and Dialer - Australian Coaching Company
description:
NursePreneur Academy helps nurses and midwives build online businesses so nursing becomes optional, not something they're stuck doing out of necessity. We're a fast-growing coaching and education brand built specifically for the healthcare space, and we're looking for a DM Setter/Dialer to join our sales team and help us book more calls with nurses ready to make a change.



This isn't a generic sales role. Our audience is nurses. Tired, overworked, big-hearted, skeptical of anything that smells like a scheme. You need to be able to talk to them like a human being who actually gets it, not a script reading machine.



What You'll Be Doing



Managing our Instagram DM inbox daily — replying to new leads, warming up conversations, and booking qualified calls

Following up with leads who've expressed interest but haven't booked yet (13-touch follow-up sequences)

Dialing and setting appointments before and after our webinars

Following up with webinar no-shows and non-converters to get them back on the phone

Hitting daily activity targets: DMs sent, follow-ups completed, calls booked

Sending an end-of-day report, on time, without being chased for it

Showing up to daily check-ins and weekly team calls, on time and prepared



What We Need From You



Excellent written and spoken English. This is non-negotiable. You'll be building trust with prospects through text and voice, so your English needs to be clean, warm, and natural, not stiff or robotic.

Dialing experience. You know how to work a phone, handle objections in real time, and keep a conversation moving without sounding pushy.

Fast ramp-up. We need someone who can hit the ground running. Within 30 days you'll be expected to be fully ramped to 125 DMs and follow-ups per day.

Empathy. Our audience is nurses. You need to genuinely relate to people who give everything at work and have nothing left for themselves. If you can't sit with someone's overwhelm before you try to move them forward, this isn't the role for you.

High say-do ratio. You do what you say you're going to do. No excuses, no chasing you for basic admin.

Coachable. You'll get direct, regular feedback. We need someone who takes it and gets better, not someone who gets defensive.

Decisive and hungry. You want to grow, you want to earn more, and you're not waiting around to be told what to do next.



Preference will be given to female candidates, given the nature of our audience and the tone of conversation that tends to land best with them.



Compensation



This role is commission-based, paid on calls closed, with a ramping commission on results. . You DM and Dial, Book qualified leads, the founder takes the call and closes it, and when it closes you get paid. Full commission structure and on-track earnings will be discussed in your interview, once we understand your experience and availability.



This is a real opportunity to grow with a company on the way up. 

Setters who perform well, do the work and stick around aren't capped (we are scaling)

Your earning potential scales with the business.



We have a webinar launching in September and are looking to bring someone on now so they're ramped and ready to go.



Trial Period



Every hire goes through a 1-2 week trial before we make it official. 

We'll be looking at how fast you pick things up, how consistently you show up, and whether your actions match your words. If that goes well, this is a long-term seat at the table, not a 3-month gig.



How to Apply



Send us a Loom video, under 5 minutes, covering:



Who you are and why you'd be a great fit for this role

Why you'd connect well with nurses specifically

Your DM setting and hiring/appointment setting experience, clearly laid out

Real numbers from your past results — DMs/follow-ups per day, bookings per day, and income generated for the business or yourself



A recording of a past dial/call you've made, attach that too. It doesn't need to be perfect, we just want to hear how you actually sound on a live call.



Examples of your DM setting process (screenshots would be preferred)



Applications without a video will not be considered. 



We're moving quickly on this one, so the sooner you apply, the better your shot.



SEND YOUR APPLICATION TO 
 with the Subject line: I'm Your DM Setter. 



No OLJ applications will be reviewed,
 only.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
KeaBabies is looking for a highly creative and detail-oriented Graphic Designer to join our global team. You will work closely with our Senior Graphic Designer in Singapore to create engaging, high-converting product images for Amazon and other platforms.



This role combines design expertise, AI-powered creativity, and e-commerce product research to help us continuously improve our listings and visual branding.



Key Responsibilities:



• Design Creation – Conceptualize and produce high-quality images for product listings, marketing materials, and brand assets.

• AI-Powered Design – Leverage AI tools for image generation, enhancement, and creative concept development.

• Amazon Product Research – Research competitor listings, market trends, and customer feedback with customer focus to spark ideas that enhance listing visuals and content.

• Collaboration – Work closely with the design team to brainstorm creative concepts that resonate with our audience.

• Image Review & Feedback – Assess images for quality, brand alignment, and compliance with Amazon guidelines; provide feedback to improve visual appeal and performance.

• File Management – Organize and maintain digital image libraries for efficient retrieval and version control.



Requirements

• Diploma or degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or related field.

• 5+ years of experience in graphic design (e-commerce or product listing experience preferred).

• Strong portfolio with e-commerce-related projects.

• Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator).

• Open to using AI tools for image generation (e.g., Midjourney, ChatGPT, Adobe Firefly, etc.); prior experience is a plus.

• Experience in e-commerce, especially with USA Amazon listings, will be a big plus.

• Strong understanding of composition, color, and visual storytelling.

• Good research skills and the ability to extract actionable insights from competitor listings.

• Strong organizational and time-management abilities.

• Excellent communication skills for working with a remote, cross-cultural team.

• Ability to meet tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

• Experience working with remote teams is a plus.

• Owns a MacOS computer or laptop with stable internet access.



Take note of these application instructions:

1. Make sure to include your resume and portfolio (either file or link) as you message us.

2. Leave a message with the title: "I want to be your next Graphic Designer!"



NOTE: No moonlighting is allowed during work hours in this role.

title: Operations Coordinator
description:
AUTOMOTIVE OPERATIONS & DISPATCH COORDINATOR

-We’re hiring a high-performing, detail-obsessed Operations Coordinator to help us run and grow a mobile automotive shop in Austin, Texas — a premium mobile tire and oil change business serving performance car owners and select fleets in the Austin metro area.

-This is a hybrid customer-facing and backend operations role. You’ll be responsible for making sure the daily work gets done accurately, efficiently, and on time — coordinating jobs, processing approvals, managing tech schedules, tracking AR, and keeping our customers in the loop.

-You’ll also assist with light marketing coordination (e.g., newsletter support, gathering photos from the team) — just a few hours weekly.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Fleet & Retail Ops Coordination

-Own the estimate-to-approval-to-route workflow:

-Create and submit estimates

-Follow up for approval

-Ensure parts are sourced

-Finalize tech routes for the following day

-Track all jobs in progress and flag issues proactively

-Ensure routes are realistic and efficient; confirm techs are prepped and ready

-Communicate clearly with customers and fleet managers about job timing, status, and follow-ups

-Submit and close out fleet approvals in Element, LeasePlan, and AutoIntegrate

-Ensure invoices match approvals; follow up on outstanding invoices and missing payments



2. Scheduling & Productivity Tracking

-Maintain the daily technician schedule, making updates as needed

-Monitor tech productivity; flag idle time, reschedules, or delays

-Track time logs and coordinate with bookkeeper for payroll



3. Customer Communication

-Respond to incoming texts, WhatsApp messages, and system inquiries in a timely, professional manner

-Follow up with clients as needed to resolve open issues or gather job-related info

-Escalate concerns appropriately and promptly



4. Admin & Reporting

-Submit a detailed Daily Recap covering completed work, pending tasks, blockers, and KPIs

-Keep Trello and other tools up-to-date with accurate job and task statuses

-Track inventory needs and coordinate ordering of parts, oil, and supplies

-Monitor A/R and follow up on past-due fleet invoices



5. Marketing & Content Support 

-Publish our monthly newsletter in MailChimp with content from marketing team

-Coordinate publishing of content to Instagram /
 / Google My Business

-Other light admin support as needed for the marketing team

-What Success Looks Like

-All work orders, estimates, approvals, and tech routes are handled with zero dropped balls

-You identify blockers or problems before they become fires

-Communication is clear, timely, and professional — with both customers and internal team

-The business runs like a machine — nothing gets missed or delayed

-You take full ownership of your responsibilities and require very little follow-up



Who You Are

-A natural systems thinker who thrives on clarity, organization, and ownership

-Extremely proactive — you don’t wait to be told what to do

-Excellent at written and verbal English communication

-Comfortable in the automotive world and eager to learn the details

-Sharp and reliable — you retain info, spot gaps, and follow through



Experience & Skills Required

-3+ years of experience in a remote automotive: coordinator, dispatcher, operations role

-Demonstrated responsibility for keeping things moving without handholding

-Excellent written and spoken English

-Experience with dispatch, route planning, or technician scheduling

-Familiar with tools like Slack, Google Docs, Trello (or similar), CRM/invoicing platforms

-Experience working with U.S.-based field service, auto, or fleet companies

-Bonus: Familiarity with AutoIntegrate, Housecall Pro, Element, or LeasePlan platforms



Required Software Experience

-Slack

-WhatsApp

-Trello (or similar)

-Google Workspace

-CRM / invoicing tools (Housecall Pro, AutoIntegrate)


 (plus)



TECH REQUIREMENTS:

-Computer - at least i5 or equivalent with 8gb RAM

-Internet Speed - At least 50 MBPS Download speed

-Dual monitor setup is required to ensure efficiency in managing multiple applications simultaneously.



Location: Remote (Philippines)

Schedule: Part-time, US hours 



Schedule

-Monday–Friday: 8:00 AM–7:00 PM CST

-Saturday: 10:00 AM–4:00 PM CST

-Sunday: 12:00 PM–4:00 PM CST

Note: Flexibility is required, as the shift schedule may change. The schedule consists of 7 shifts across 2 weeks. 



Pay:  ₱288.46 - ₱432.69 hourly rate

title: Australian Mortgage Parabroker / Loan Processor
description:
About us



We are an Australian mortgage brokerage based in Sydney. We write residential loans with a strong focus on self-employed and complex income clients, including company borrowers, trusts and multi-entity structures.



We are a small team, so this role carries real ownership of files rather than sitting at the bottom of a processing chain. Do the job well and this is a long term seat with clear pay progression.



About the role



We need someone to take loan applications from initial assessment all the way through to settlement.



Please read this part carefully. This is not an entry level VA or admin role. You need to have worked on Australian mortgage applications already, understand lender credit policy, and be able to assess self-employed income without being walked through it. If your experience is limited to data entry, chasing documents and ticking checklists, this will not be a fit.



What you will do



Assessment and structuring



Assess PAYG income including base, overtime, bonuses and allowances

Assess self-employed income from company financials, tax returns and Notices of Assessment

Apply salary and wages paid to applicants from their own business, and company profit where lender policy permits

Apply depreciation and other common addbacks, and identify one-off or non-recurring expenses

Work across companies, trusts, sole traders, related entities and group structures

Complete lender servicing calculations and compare borrowing capacity across lenders

Recommend suitable lender and product options for the client's circumstances



Credit and compliance



Review Equifax credit reports and flag adverse credit, defaults and enquiries

Assess liabilities, credit limits, living expenses and commitments

Prepare Credit Proposals and Preliminary Assessments

Write clear Best Interests Duty commentary, lender comparisons and reasons for recommendation

Document client objectives and priorities, borrowing capacity, servicing and credit history commentary

Keep the fact find, compliance documents and lender application consistent with each other



Pre-submission



Obtain loan pricing requests and order property valuations

Complete Equifax credit checks

Cross-check income, liabilities, assets and expenses

Confirm the application meets lender policy before it goes in

Prepare lender submission notes so files are clean on first submission



Through to settlement



Submit through ApplyOnline and lender portals

Monitor progress and chase outstanding lender requirements

Deal directly with lender BDMs and credit assessors, and respond to conditions

Coordinate additional documents from clients

Work conditional approval through to unconditional, loan documents and settlement

Keep CRM notes and milestones accurate the whole way through

What you must have

[2]+ years preparing and submitting Australian mortgage applications

Proven experience with self-employed and company borrower files, not only PAYG

Experience across investment, owner-occupied, refinance and cash-out applications

Ability to run a file end to end without supervision

Solid understanding of Australian broking compliance, including Best Interests Duty

Strong written English. You will write compliance commentary and lender notes that we submit as they are

Confident spoken English for calls with BDMs and credit assessors

Reliable home office, stable internet of at least 25 Mbps, backup internet and backup power

Willing to sign a confidentiality agreement. You will handle client financials and credit reports

Systems



Experience with any of these is a strong advantage. Tell us how long you have used each, and say so honestly if you have not used one:



Salestrekker (2.0 preferred) or a comparable broking CRM

ApplyOnline

Quickli

Lender servicing calculators

Equifax

Nice to have

Cert IV in Finance and Mortgage Broking or equivalent Australian study

Commercial or asset finance experience

Who does well here

Detail obsessed. You catch the missing payslip before the assessor does

Organised, and able to run several live applications at once

Proactive. You move a file forward without being told each step

Good at problem solving. Complex self-employed scenarios interest you rather than scare you

Consistent with follow ups and timelines

description:
We are seeking a highly experienced Company Controller to serve as the senior accounting lead for an established Hawaii-based multi-trade contractor supporting commercial and institutional facilities.



The company provides roofing, HVAC/R, commercial doors, electrical, plumbing, and general maintenance services. The Controller will own the financial books, job-cost integrity, month-end close, and management reporting while partnering closely with company leadership and operations.



This is not a routine bookkeeping or data-entry role. The successful candidate must be capable of independently overseeing the company’s complete accounting function and turning operational activity, including work orders, vendor bills, payroll, subcontractor costs, and customer billings, into accurate financial information leadership can trust.



The position is fully remote and open to qualified Philippines-based professionals under an independent-contractor arrangement.



Key Responsibilities



*Financial Accounting and Close

Own the full accounting cycle from transaction coding through month-end and year-end close

Maintain the general ledger, chart of accounts, and accounting policies

Lead monthly, quarterly, and annual closing activities according to an established calendar

Prepare accurate trial balances and financial statements

Reconcile cash, accounts receivable, accounts payable, prepaid expenses, accrued liabilities, WIP, retainage, fixed assets, and other balance-sheet accounts

Prepare and review journal entries and investigate unusual variances before reports are released

Coordinate with external CPAs, tax advisers, auditors, and other accounting professionals as needed

Maintain accounting practices consistent with US GAAP or other company-adopted standards



*Job Costing, WIP and Project Financials

Maintain accurate job-cost records for labor, materials, equipment, subcontractors, overhead, and other direct costs

Prepare and review work-in-progress schedules

Identify underbilling, overbilling, cost overruns, missing costs, billing gaps, and potential margin risks

Ensure job costs and WIP accurately reflect the operational status of each work order or project

Partner with operations, project managers, and administration to ensure completed work, approved quotes, NTEs, customer invoices, and applicable revenue-recognition practices remain aligned

Provide actual-versus-estimate and gross-margin analysis for active and completed jobs

Communicate financial risks and discrepancies to leadership promptly



*Accounts Receivable and Billing Oversight

Oversee customer invoicing workflows to ensure completed work is billed promptly and accurately

Monitor accounts-receivable aging and coordinate follow-up on past-due balances

Reconcile customer deposits, progress billings, retainage, credit memos, and related accounts

Work with operations and administrative teams to secure the supporting documentation required for customer billing and payment



*Accounts Payable, Vendors and Subcontractors

Oversee accounts-payable intake, coding, approval routing, and payment runs

Ensure vendor and subcontractor invoices are assigned to the correct jobs or work orders

Maintain complete vendor records, payment terms, and applicable W-9 or tax documentation

Prevent duplicate payments and assist in resolving invoice discrepancies and vendor disputes



*Cash, Banking and Working Capital

Maintain clear daily and weekly visibility of cash balances, upcoming obligations, and expected receipts

Reconcile bank and credit-card accounts and clear outstanding items promptly

Prepare or support cash-flow forecasts for company leadership

Help improve working capital through effective billing, collections, and payment timing



*Payroll Coordination and Cost Allocation

Coordinate with internal or outsourced payroll providers

Ensure labor costs are allocated to the correct jobs, departments, and general-ledger accounts

Review payroll liabilities, employer taxes, benefits accruals, and related accounts for completeness

Support appropriate labor-burden and overhead-allocation methods for job costing



*Reporting, Controls and Systems

Prepare recurring management reports, including the income statement, balance sheet, cash position, AR/AP aging, job profitability, and WIP

Translate financial results into clear, practical recommendations for leadership

Design, document, and strengthen internal controls appropriate to the company’s size and operations

Maintain audit-ready records and documentation

Reconcile accounting systems, work-order or CMMS exports, and spreadsheet trackers

Identify opportunities to improve financial processes, systems, and source-data quality

Document accounting procedures to ensure continuity and consistency

Protect confidential company, financial, customer, vendor, and employee information



*Cross-Functional Partnership

Work closely with company leadership, directors, project and resource management, operations, and administration

Help operations understand job profitability, margins, cash flow, billing issues, and cost-control opportunities

Support system implementations, historical account cleanup, new entities or locations, and other special projects

Guide or train administrative staff responsible for entering bills, invoices, payroll information, or job costs



*Qualifications and Skills

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field

Proven experience as a Controller, Assistant Controller, or Senior Accountant in construction, facilities services, field services, or another project-based business

Strong knowledge of full-cycle accounting, general-ledger management, and financial reporting

Demonstrated experience independently leading month-end and year-end close

Strong job-costing and WIP experience within a project-based or work-order environment

Working knowledge of US GAAP

Strong understanding of accounts payable, accounts receivable, cash flow, internal controls, and audit readiness

Advanced Microsoft Excel skills

Experience with QuickBooks Online/Desktop, Xero, NetSuite, or similar accounting systems

Comfortable learning work-order, CMMS, or facilities-management platforms

Excellent written and spoken English for communication with US-based stakeholders

Strong analytical skills and the ability to explain financial information clearly

High level of integrity, ownership, accuracy, and professional judgment

Able to work independently and meet strict reporting and closing deadlines

Reliable internet connection, secure workspace, and appropriate remote-working equipment



*Preferred Experience

Philippine-licensed CPA, US CPA, or equivalent professional accounting qualification

Previous experience supporting a US-based company

Accounting experience in construction, facilities services, field services, or another project-based industry

Direct experience with job costing, WIP, retainage, progress billing, labor allocation, and revenue recognition

Experience working with multiple trades, departments, entities, or locations

Experience partnering directly with company owners, executives, operations leaders, or project managers

Experience supervising, reviewing, or training accounting and administrative team members



*Schedule and Work Arrangement

Full-time; exact weekly hours and schedule to be confirmed

Fully remote and open to Philippines-based candidates

Independent-contractor engagement

Must be available for scheduled collaboration with Hawaii-based leadership

Regular overlap with Hawaii Standard Time will be required for meetings, accounting questions, month-end close, billing deadlines, and other time-sensitive matters

Candidates must clearly state their availability and time zone



How to Apply

Please submit the following:

- A brief application letter introducing yourself and explaining your relevant Controller experience

- A link to your updated résumé or CV

- A summary of your experience with US accounting and US GAAP

- Details of your construction, job-costing, WIP, retainage, or project-accounting experience

- A list of the accounting, ERP, work-order, and reporting systems you have used

- Your current availability and ability to overlap with Hawaii Standard Time

- Your expected hourly rate or monthly compensation in USD

- Confirmation of any active CPA license or equivalent professional accounting qualification, if applicable



Please ensure that all submitted links are accessible.



 Subject Line

CONTROLLER REPS – YOUR FULL NAME



Only complete applications that follow the instructions above will be considered.

title: Short-Form Lifestyle Video Editor
description:
Remote | Flexible Hours | EST Time Zone | Immediate Start



We’re looking for a highly creative Short-Form Video Editor who knows how to turn everyday footage into engaging, cinematic, masculine lifestyle content for Instagram.



Think: “Day in the Life” content, routines, work, fitness, travel, ambition, lifestyle, discipline, behind-the-scenes, and personal-brand content, edited in a way that feels premium, modern, natural, and addictive to watch.



This is not a basic talking-head editing role. We want someone who understands visual storytelling, pacing, music, transitions, sound design, B-roll, and attention retention.



What You'll Do

Edit 12–15 short-form videos per month for Instagram/Reels

Turn raw lifestyle footage into high-quality, engaging short-form content

Create strong hooks and pacing that keep viewers watching

Use B-roll, cinematic cuts, speed ramps, sound design, music, text, and transitions appropriately

Build a consistent visual style across all content

Understand how to make ordinary daily-life footage feel interesting, aspirational, and cinematic

Adapt editing based on feedback and continuously improve the content

Stay updated with current Instagram/Reels editing styles and trends

The Style We're Looking For



You should naturally understand content like:



Masculine Day in the Life

Morning/night routines

Business & entrepreneur lifestyle

Fitness & discipline

Travel & luxury lifestyle

Behind-the-scenes content

Cinematic personal branding

Fast-paced but clean storytelling

“Come with me” / POV-style content

Aspirational lifestyle reels



We want the content to feel premium and authentic, not like a cheap template slapped onto random clips.



Requirements

Proven experience editing Instagram Reels / TikTok / YouTube Shorts

Strong understanding of short-form storytelling and retention

Excellent sense of pacing, music selection, and visual composition

Strong knowledge of editing software such as Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, etc.

C1/C2 level English communication — you must be able to understand instructions, communicate clearly, and handle feedback professionally

Reliable, high-speed internet connection

Able to consistently deliver 12–15 videos per month

Comfortable working primarily around EST hours, with flexibility when needed

Reliable and responsive communication

Available to start ASAP

Portfolio - REQUIRED



Please share your portfolio/reel when applying.



We are particularly interested in seeing:



Lifestyle / Day-in-the-Life / Personal Brand / Cinematic / Masculine / Fitness / Entrepreneurial content.



If your portfolio is mostly corporate videos, wedding videos, gaming edits, or basic talking-head clips, this probably isn't the right role.



What We Value



Creative judgment > fancy effects.



We care about whether you can take raw footage and think:



“How do I make someone actually want to watch this?”



If you have a strong eye for storytelling and can make simple footage look cinematic, engaging, and aspirational, we'd love to see your work.



Start Date: ASAP

Work Setup: Fully Remote

Schedule: EST-based, flexible

Monthly Output: 12–15 videos

title: AI Product Builder / Internal Tools Developer
description:
About Us



Bilsmidigt is a Swedish online car dealership based in Stockholm.



We are changing the way people buy and sell used cars by making the process more digital, simple, and convenient. Customers can browse and purchase cars online, have their car delivered to their home, and get a straightforward buying experience without the traditional dealership process.



Behind the scenes, we have a growing team working across sales, purchasing, logistics, workshop, customer service, marketing, and operations.



As we grow, we are building more and more internal tools to make these teams work faster and more efficiently.



That's where you come in.





About the Role



We are looking for a fast, curious, and highly independent AI Product Builder based in the Philippines to join our team full-time.



We build internal tools that help our team work more efficiently. Today, much of the building happens directly through Lovable and Claude, but this has become a bottleneck because too much depends on one person being available to build and iterate on every tool.



We want someone who can take ownership of that work.



You do not need to be a traditional software engineer or have a computer science degree. What matters most is that you are technical enough to understand how things work, comfortable with AI tools, great at problem solving, and able to turn an idea into a working tool quickly.



What You'll Do



You will:



• Build and improve internal tools using Lovable and AI-powered development tools

• Use Claude and other AI tools as part of your everyday workflow

• Take rough business requirements like "We need this process to work like this" and turn them into a working solution

• Ask the right questions when requirements are unclear

• Rapidly prototype, test, iterate, and improve tools

• Troubleshoot issues and fix things when they break

• Test tools from an actual user's perspective before handing them over

• Follow up on tools after launch and improve them based on feedback

• Work closely with our team in Sweden to understand business needs and translate them into practical solutions



How We Work



We value speed, ownership, and iteration.



Five useful iterations in one day are better than spending a week creating the "perfect" plan.



You should be comfortable with:



Build → Test → Get feedback → Improve → Repeat



We don't expect long specifications before starting. We want someone who can look at a problem, understand what we're trying to achieve, build something, and keep improving it.



What We're Looking For



Must have:



• Strong problem-solving skills

• Comfortable learning and using AI tools

• Very comfortable experimenting with new technology

• Fast learner who can figure things out independently

• Strong written English

• Able to understand business needs, not just technical requirements

• Able to work independently without constant supervision

• Good attention to detail

• Comfortable working with a team remotely and communicating primarily through written communication

• Willingness to take ownership of a project from idea through implementation and follow-up



Technical experience is a plus:



• Lovable

• Claude / ChatGPT or other AI development tools

• Basic HTML/CSS/JavaScript

• Databases and SQL

• APIs and integrations

• Git/GitHub

• Supabase

• Automation tools such as Make, Zapier, or similar

• Experience building internal tools, dashboards, workflows, or web applications



A formal developer or computer science degree is not required.



If you've built things yourself, learned technology independently, and can show us what you've made, we'd much rather see that than a degree.



The Ideal Person



You might be a good fit if you are the kind of person who:



• Sees a problem and immediately thinks, "I can probably build something for that."

• Enjoys figuring out how new AI tools work

• Doesn't need everything explained step by step

• Can turn a vague idea into a working prototype

• Isn't afraid of breaking something while experimenting

• Learns quickly from mistakes

• Enjoys building practical things rather than writing code just for the sake of writing code

• Takes ownership instead of waiting for someone to tell you what to do next



Working Hours



-This is a full-time, long-term position.

-You will work with a team based in Sweden, so you need to have good overlap with Swedish office hours (CET/CEST).

-We are looking for someone who can be available for regular communication during overlapping working hours.



Compensation



We are open to discussing compensation with exceptional candidates who bring strong relevant experience.



This is intended to be a long-term position, not a short-term freelance project.



Hiring Process



We want to see how you actually work, not just how good your CV looks.



How to Apply



Please send:



1. Your CV

2. A short introduction about yourself

3. Examples of things you have built (These can be websites, internal tools, automations, dashboards, AI projects, personal projects, or anything else you're proud of).

4. Tell us which AI tools you regularly use (For example: Claude, ChatGPT, Lovable, Cursor, Replit, Bolt, etc.)

5. Tell us about one thing you built that you're particularly proud of. (What was the problem, what did you build, and what tools did you use?)

6. Your expected monthly salary in USD



Please include the word "BUILDER" at the beginning of your application so we know you have read the full job post.



We are looking for someone who wants to build, learn, experiment, and grow with us long-term.



If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Shopify Developer (Full-Time)
description:
About Us



Local Marketing Audit is a U.S.-based marketing agency helping brands grow through strategy, design, and performance-driven execution. Our clients range from emerging DTC labels to established retailers, and ecommerce is one of the fastest-growing parts of our business. We're hiring a Shopify Developer to own that work end to end.



The Role



You'll build, launch, and maintain Shopify stores for our clients — from new builds and theme customization to ongoing optimization, app integrations, and performance tuning. This is a hands-on development role with direct client exposure, so we're looking for someone who can write clean code and also explain trade-offs in plain language.



What You'll Do



- Build and launch new Shopify and Shopify Plus stores from concept through go-live

- Customize themes using Liquid, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript

- Manage and maintain existing client stores: updates, bug fixes, feature additions

- Integrate third-party apps, payment gateways, shipping tools, and marketing platforms

- Migrate stores from other platforms to Shopify when needed

- Optimize site speed, mobile experience, and conversion-critical page templates

- Set up product catalogs, collections, variants, and inventory structures

- Troubleshoot issues quickly and communicate status clearly to internal teams and clients

- Partner with designers, strategists, and account managers to ship work on schedule



What We're Looking For



- Proven experience building and managing successful Shopify stores — we want to see live sites you've shipped and can speak to

- Strong command of Liquid, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript

- Working knowledge of the Shopify ecosystem: apps, APIs, theme architecture, Shopify Plus features

- Experience with store performance optimization and conversion-focused development

- Comfort managing multiple projects and deadlines at once

- Clear written and verbal English communication



Nice to Have



- WordPress development experience, especially WooCommerce store builds and maintenance

- PHP, and familiarity with custom plugin or theme work

- Headless commerce experience (Hydrogen, Next.js)

- Basic familiarity with GA4, Meta Pixel, and conversion tracking setup

- Experience working in an agency environment with multiple concurrent clients



Why Join Us



- Varied, meaningful work across a real portfolio of ecommerce brands

- A collaborative team that values craft and clear communication

- Room to grow into technical leadership as our ecommerce practice expands



How to Apply



Please include the following with your application:



1. Portfolio — links to live Shopify stores you've built or managed, with a short note on your specific role in each

2. CV / resume

3. Monthly salary expectation (in USD)

title: Construction Project Administrator for Australian Custom Home Builder
description:
Merbain is a building company based in Brisbane, Australia. We specialise in high-end, architect-designed custom homes and typically deliver three to four projects each year.



We are a small team consisting of four carpenters, an admin and myself. There is no head office. This is a fully remote position working directly with our existing administrator and the director.



We are looking for another experienced and highly organised person to help keep the administrative and project side of the business moving.



What you would be doing



Every construction project generates a large volume of documentation, tracking and follow-up. We need someone who can take ownership of this work, maintain visibility over outstanding items and follow tasks through until they are complete.



Your work would include:



• Maintaining job files, document registers and maintenance schedules

• Entering and maintaining information in JobTread, including budgets and cost reports

• Preparing safety and onboarding packs for subcontractors

• Following up certificates, insurances, licences and warranties until everything is received and filed correctly

• Requesting supplier and subcontractor quotes and preparing accurate side-by-side comparisons

• Checking quotes, invoices and documents against the relevant scope and source information

• Maintaining task trackers, meeting action lists, time logs and project follow-ups

• Helping develop and maintain company procedures and SOPs

• Tracking client progress and coordinating follow-ups during construction and after handover

• Organising site photo libraries and project records

• Assisting with finish schedules, sample flat lays, testimonials, client gifts and occasional marketing content

• Using AI to draft correspondence, research information and improve administrative processes

• Checking AI-generated work against original sources before relying on or sending it

• Providing clear progress updates and raising questions or blockers early



This role is primarily focused on project administration, research and development, documentation, compliance and follow-up, with some client and brand support.



What we are looking for



• Strong written English and the confidence to communicate directly with Australian clients, suppliers and subcontractors

• Excellent attention to detail and the ability to identify inconsistencies or missing information

• Confidence using Microsoft Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel and OneDrive

• Strong practical experience using AI tools for administrative and business tasks

• The ability to verify AI-generated information rather than accepting it at face value

• Someone who takes ownership and follows tasks through to completion

• Someone who acknowledges new tasks, confirms deadlines and communicates early if something may not be completed on time

• Someone who asks questions when unsure rather than making unsupported assumptions

• Someone who can manage recurring responsibilities during quieter periods and adapt when urgent work arises

• Someone comfortable working directly with a small business owner where priorities can occasionally change

Experience supporting an Australian construction, property, maintenance or trades business is strongly preferred.

Experience with JobTread/Buildertrend, Programma, Canva or similar project management systems would also be helpful, but training will be provided.

Because the team is small, you will occasionally be asked to help with things outside this list.



Hours and contractor fee



• 40 hours per week

• We are open Monday to Friday, 7am to 4pm Philippine time, assumed one-hour unpaid break

• All-inclusive contractor fee of PHP 20,000 to PHP 25,000 per week, depending on relevant experience and demonstrated capability

• Paid weekly in PHP via Wise

• This is an independent contractor position, so you will be responsible for your own taxes and contributions

• Ongoing role, not project based

• We are looking for someone available to start within the next two weeks



How to apply



Please include the following in your application:

title: # Amazon FBA Virtual Assistant (Amazon Australia — Private Label & Wholesale)
description:
Amazon FBA Virtual Assistant (Amazon Australia — Private Label & Wholesale)



Type:** Remote, part-time contract

Hours:** 15–20 per week to start, with room to grow

Primary marketplace:** 
 (Australia)

Secondary marketplace:** 
 (US)

Business model:** Private label + wholesale resale of established brands



 About the Role



I run a growing Amazon FBA business with **Amazon Australia as the main focus**, built on **private label products and wholesale resale of established brands**. Amazon US is a secondary marketplace that will grow over time.



Your work will be Australia-first: private label listings and launches, wholesale sourcing from Australian suppliers and distributors, brand and category ungating, Seller Central management, inventory, PPC monitoring and product research. The long-term goal is for you to **own Amazon operations end to end.**



If you've run private label products, sourced profitable wholesale deals, worked hands-on inside Seller Central, can spot a problem before it becomes an account health issue, and like being trusted to run things without being chased, this role is for you.



This is not a beginner position.



What You'll Do



 Private Label (Amazon AU)

- Research and validate private label opportunities in the Australian market

- Support new product launches: listing creation, launch strategy and early review generation

- Own listing optimisation: titles, bullet points, descriptions, backend keywords and A+ Content

- Track competitor pricing, listings and reviews on our private label ASINs

- Support brand protection: Brand Registry, monitoring for hijackers and IP infringement

- Assist with supplier communication, samples and production timelines



 Wholesale Sourcing & Resale

- Find and vet brands, distributors and wholesale suppliers — Australian suppliers first, then US

- Draft supplier outreach and help open new wholesale accounts

- Analyse supplier price lists in bulk to find profitable ASINs

- Evaluate resale opportunities: sales rank and velocity, Buy Box price history, number of FBA sellers, whether Amazon is on the listing (Keepa, SellerAmp) — noting that AU data is thinner than US, so judgement matters

- Calculate landed cost, Amazon AU fees, GST and profit margin before any purchase

- Check brand/category gating, hazmat, IP complaint risk and brand restrictions before buying

- Assist with purchase orders, prep and inbound shipments

- Monitor Buy Box share and pricing on resale ASINs



 Brand & Category Ungating

- Identify gated brands and categories blocking profitable ASINs on Amazon AU (and US where relevant)

- Check approval requirements for each brand, category and marketplace in Seller Central

- Collect compliant documentation from authorised suppliers: genuine invoices that meet Amazon's requirements, supplier contact details and any letters of authorisation

- Prepare and submit ungating applications through Seller Central

- Handle rejections: work out why an application failed, fix the issue and resubmit

- Maintain an ungating tracker: gated brands/categories, requirements, status, approval dates

- Spot auto-approval and easy-ungate opportunities

- Only ever use genuine, unaltered documentation — protecting account health comes first



Seller Central & Account Health

- Handle daily Seller Central tasks: customer messages, returns, refunds and basic Seller Support cases

- Monitor Account Health, listing status, suppressed listings, Buy Box and pricing

- Flag potential account issues immediately — especially IP complaints, authenticity claims and policy warnings



FBA Inventory & Shipments

- Track inventory levels, identify stockout risks and support restock planning

- Create and monitor FBA inbound shipments

- Manage stranded and excess inventory

- Investigate lost or damaged inventory and file reimbursement claims where appropriate



 Amazon PPC

- Monitor campaigns, ad spend, ACoS, TACoS and conversion rate

- Identify wasted spend

- Recommend keyword, bid and campaign improvements



 Product & Competitor Research

- Research product opportunities for Amazon Australia first, then the US

- Analyse demand, competition, pricing and estimated profitability in the AU market

- Deliver clear research reports with a recommendation: pursue, investigate further, or skip



 Weekly Report

A short weekly report (Google Sheets) covering:

- Sales, units sold and revenue

- Advertising spend, ACoS and TACoS

- Buy Box share on wholesale ASINs

- Wholesale pipeline: suppliers contacted, accounts opened, new ASINs approved

- Ungating: applications submitted, approved and rejected

- Inventory position and stockout risks

- Best-selling and slow-moving products

- Important account issues

- Your recommended actions for the week ahead



What Success Looks Like



First 30 days:** You know the AU account, catalogue, suppliers and tools. Weekly reports are running, and nothing slips through on account health or inventory.

60–90 days:** You're bringing in new profitable AU wholesale ASINs, supplier accounts and brand/category approvals, and supporting private label launches, and proactively recommending listing, PPC and restock actions that move the numbers.

Long term:** You own Amazon AU operations and help scale the US marketplace, and your hours grow with the business.



 Must-Haves



Hands-on experience working inside Amazon Seller Central

Amazon Australia experience** — this is the primary marketplace

Private label experience:** launching and managing your own branded products

Wholesale resale experience:** sourcing suppliers, analysing price lists and buying profitable ASINs

Proven ungating experience:** successfully getting brand and category approvals on Amazon

Examples of previous Amazon work you can walk me through

Strong written and spoken English

Solid Google Sheets / Excel skills

Ability to work independently with strong attention to detail

Reliable internet connection

 Strong Advantages



- Amazon US experience alongside AU — managing both is a major plus

- Existing relationships with Australian brands, distributors and suppliers

- Understanding of the AU market: GST, local logistics and prep partners

- Experience ungating on Amazon Australia

- Experience with repricers and Buy Box strategy

- Amazon PPC management experience

- Private label experience

- Tools: Keepa, SellerAmp, Helium 10, Jungle Scout, Sellerboard, Tactical Arbitrage or similar



This Role Is Not a Fit If



- You've never personally worked inside Seller Central

- You've only worked on Amazon US and know nothing about the AU marketplace

- You've never sourced wholesale products for Amazon

- You've never successfully ungated a brand or category

- Your experience is limited to an FBA course or YouTube tutorials

- You can't share examples of previous Amazon work

- You need constant supervision



- How to Apply



Generic or copy-and-paste applications will not be reviewed.



> **Start your application with the words: AMAZON AUSTRALIA + USA**

> Then answer every question below, numbered.



**Experience**

1. How many years have you worked with Amazon FBA?

2. How many Amazon stores have you managed?

3. Have you personally worked inside Amazon Seller Central? What did you handle day to day?

4. Have you worked with Amazon Australia? Describe your responsibilities and how long for.

5. Have you worked with Amazon US? Describe your responsibilities.

6. What type of Amazon businesses have you worked with — private label, wholesale, arbitrage or other?



**Private Label**

7. Have you launched or managed private label products? Describe the brand, category and your role.

8. What's your approach to launching a new private label product on Amazon AU?



**Wholesale**

9. How have you found and opened wholesale supplier accounts? Roughly how many have you opened, and in which countries?

10. Walk me through how you d
 whether a wholesale ASIN is worth buying.

11. Describe one wholesale product you recommended buying: the numbers behind it (cost, fees, ROI, sales velocity, competition) and the result.



**Ungating**

12. Which brands or categories have you successfully ungated, and on which marketplace (AU, US)?

13. Walk me through your ungating process. What documents do you prepare, and what do you do when an application is rejected?



**Skills & Tools**

14. Have you managed Amazon PPC? Which campaign types and tools did you use?

15. Which tools have you used — Keepa, SellerAmp, Helium 10, Jungle Scout, Sellerboard or others?



**Proof of Work**

16. Describe one difficult Amazon problem you solved: what happened, what you did, and the result.



**Logistics**

17. What is your hourly rate (USD)?

18. How many hours per week can you work, and what time zone are you in?

19. When can you start?



Applications that don't follow these instructions will not be considered.



 Hiring Process



1. Application review

2. Short interview

3. Paid Amazon FBA test task

4. Paid trial period



---



I'm looking for a reliable, long-term team member who treats this business like their own — not a short-term gig. If that's you, I look forward to your application.

title: Basic Headline Editor
description:

Exchange Life · Fully Remote · Full-Time Contractor · ~40 hrs/week $5 USD/hour + $300–$800/month in performance bonuses

About Exchange Life

Exchange Life is a fast-growing e-commerce travel jewelry brand. We sell collectible country charms for travelers, with new product lines launching soon. Our content team of editors, filmmakers, and creators works fully remotely across the world.

This role is a starting point, and we're straight about that — it's focused work editing headline videos to a proven format. But it's a starting point on a team that promotes from the inside. Many of our editors have been with us two or more years, and the ones who started here are now the people briefing everyone else.

Where You'll Be in Six Months

AI Advanced Editor.

That's the next title, and it's the step most of our strong headline editors make inside their first six months. An AI Advanced Editor works on our highest-leverage creative: AI-assisted video, hook development, and the ad formats we scale behind. You stop working purely to a template and start building the ones other people follow.

It's d
 by performance, not tenure. Produce winners consistently and you'll get there sooner.

What You'll Earn

Performance bonuses: $300–$800/month, paid per winning creative — when a video you cut hits our performance thresholds or scales on paid, you get paid for it

There's no cap on how good your month can be

What Success Looks Like

Within three to six months, you're consistently producing headline videos that perform on both paid and organic channels — 50%+ thumb-stop rates and 30%+ hold rates — and iterating on winning formats without needing day-to-day direction.

Responsibilities

Edit TikTok and Reels headline content optimized for hook rate, retention, and watch time

Review past edits daily, identify what is and isn't working, and apply those lessons

Work with the marketing team to test new creative angles and iterate on proven formats

Turn work around quickly and communicate proactively each day

Track TikTok and Instagram trends and apply them where relevant

Requirements

Preferred

What You'll Learn Here

Most editing roles teach you software. This one teaches you why things sell. You'll get direct access to paid ad data on real spend, see which of your creatives print money and which die, and build the one skill that makes editors expensive: knowing what to make before you make it.

Access to courses and paid software

title: Finance & Cashflow Manager
description:
Finance & Cash Flow Manager — Remote, Part-Time

E-Commerce · Subscription Business · DTC Brand



We run a growing direct-to-consumer brand with a subscription model. We spend six figures a month on paid advertising across Meta and operate multiple stores. We need someone detail-oriented, reliable, and comfortable with numbers to own our day-to-day financial tracking.



This is a numbers-first role. You tell us exactly where we stand — not just at month end, but daily.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Daily Finance Tracking

Log daily ad spend per store (Meta), record daily orders and revenue, track front-end sales vs subscription rebill revenue separately, calculate daily CPA, and flag any day where CPA exceeds agreed thresholds.



Subscription Rebill Tracking

Track biweekly subscription billing cycles per customer cohort, log which bill number each cohort is on, record actual subscription revenue vs projected, and track approval rates on each billing attempt.



Cost of Goods & Order Management

Track COG per order across stores, ensure COG invoices are paid on schedule, and flag any discrepancy between orders and COG invoiced.



Customer Service Coordination (light)

Work with our CS team to stay on top of refund volumes and compile a simple weekly summary of refunds and chargebacks. Basic awareness of processing fees helpful.



Cash Flow & Bank Balance

Maintain a live business bank account balance tracker updated daily. Track payout timing from our payment processor and flag immediately if the balance is getting tight.



Reporting

Weekly P&L summary every Monday. Monthly profit report broken down by store. Maintain the master Google Sheet tracker.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Must have:



Strong Google Sheets skills — formulas, formatting, comfortable building trackers from scratch

Experience tracking finances for an e-commerce or similar business

Understanding of subscription billing and recurring revenue

Works independently with minimal supervision

Available daily to log and update numbers

Responds within a few hours during business hours

Fluent English — clear written communication



Nice to have:



Experience with Shopify or similar platforms

Familiarity with Meta Ads Manager

Previous work with subscription, dropshipping, or e-commerce businesses



KEY METRICS YOU WILL OWN



Daily CPA · Bank balance · Refund rate · Chargeback rate · COG payments



Numbers must be updated daily. Accuracy is everything.



WHAT THIS IS NOT



Not a bookkeeping or accounting role. Not a one-hour-a-week job — this requires daily attention. Not a passive role — we need someone who flags issues before they become problems.



PAY



We are very open on pay. Quality is what matters to us — if you are genuinely good at this, the compensation will reflect it.



HOW TO APPLY



Send a short message covering:



Your experience tracking finances for an e-commerce or subscription business

A specific example of a cash flow or tracking problem you caught and resolved

Your Google Sheets skills — be specific about what you have built

Your hourly or monthly rate

Your daily availability and timezone



To confirm you have read this post, start your application with #subscriptionjewels — applications without this will not be considered.

title: Illustrator and Print Designer
description:
We are seeking a creative and talented designer to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for coming up with patterns for textile products and assisting in other projects such as packaging and illustrations for baby/maternity industry. The designer will be expected to work collaboratively with our team to produce high-quality designs and assist in other design projects as and when required.



Responsibilities:

• Concept & Trend Innovation: Conduct research into baby/children's market trends, then conceptualize and develop innovative print themes, color palettes, and design directions that resonate with our audience and align with KeaBabies' brand, leveraging • AI tools for accelerated ideation and visual exploration.

• Original Illustration: Create engaging, unique, and high-quality illustrations specifically tailored for KeaBabies' range of baby and children's products, such as swaddles, blankets, and bibs.

• Print & Pattern Design: Design seamless repeat patterns and distinctive print layouts for diverse product applications, ensuring all designs are optimized for manufacturing processes.

• Packaging Design: Assist in developing compelling and functional packaging designs that are on-brand, protect the product, and significantly enhance the overall customer experience.

• Production Readiness & Quality: Ensure all designs are production-ready and technically sound, meeting high-quality standards. This includes preparing accurate files and maintaining organized project records.

• Market Insight & Adaptation: Continuously monitor industry trends, competitor designs, and consumer preferences within the baby/children's market to directly inform and elevate design decisions.



Job Details:

• Salary: USD 450 to USD 600 per month

• Working Hours: 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM (GMT+8)

• Working Days: Monday to Friday



Requirements:

• A Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Illustration, or a related field.

• Portfolio: A strong, diverse, and professional online portfolio is mandatory. It must clearly showcase exceptional illustration skills, a deep understanding of color theory, and the ability to create seamless repeat patterns. Examples relevant to the baby and children's product industry are highly preferred.

• Industry Knowledge: A deep understanding of current design trends, consumer preferences, and aesthetic styles within the baby and children's product market.

title: Supply Chain Manager (Multi-Channel E-commerce, Asia-to-Europe Imports)
description:
READ THIS FIRST

We do not review applications sent through Onlinejobs.ph. That includes messages, the Apply button and attached resumes. The only way to apply is through the form linked at the bottom of this post.



ABOUT OLVY

Olvy B.V. is a Dutch consumer brand selling kitchen and home appliances across Europe and the UK, on Amazon and through other sales channels. We make our products in China, ship them by sea to Europe and fulfil through Amazon FBA and outside fulfilment partners. We're growing into more countries and channels. We need one person to own inventory, freight and partner performance so the supply chain keeps up with that growth.



This is not a coordinator or VA role. You'll set the rules that others follow. You'll also manage a Supply Chain Coordinator.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



1. Inventory planning

- Set safety stock, coverage targets and reorder points, and explain the reasoning behind each number

- D
 order quantities around supplier MOQs and full-container limits

- Build and maintain a rolling 12-month forecast that covers seasonal peaks and promotional events

- Watch inventory health and act early on overstock and slow sellers

- Direct the weekly replenishment runs to every fulfilment channel through your Coordinator



2. Imports from Asia to Europe

- Negotiate incoterms, prices and payment terms with suppliers

- Plan sea, rail and air shipments, and cost the freight premium against what a stockout would cost

- Improve container use and bring down freight cost per unit sold

- Handle customs, import documents and EU product compliance issues



3. Fulfilment partners and suppliers

- Define SLAs with 3PL and fulfilment partners, measure them and review them every month

- Escalate or replace partners who miss their SLAs

- Rate suppliers on actual lead time, delivery reliability and quality

- Arrange pre-shipment inspections and follow up on what they find



4. Data, reporting and processes

- Own the KPI definitions and report forecast accuracy every month

- Question what the tools say. When a report looks wrong, check it against the real data.

- Document processes so the work doesn't depend on one person

- Design the logistics setup for new countries and channels, including storage, returns, imports and VAT registration with finance



5. Must-Haves (please don't apply without all 7)

- 5 to 10 years in supply chain, including at least 2 years where you were responsible for inventory norms or a fulfilment network. Following rules someone else set doesn't count.

- Hands-on experience importing from Asia to Europe: incoterms, sea freight, container planning and customs. Domestic-only or US-only logistics doesn't qualify.

- Experience managing outside 3PL or fulfilment partners against written SLAs. You should be able to name the metrics and what happened when a partner missed them.

- Inventory planning at the parameter level. You've set safety stock or coverage figures yourself and can explain why they sit where they do.

- Strong analytical skills. You build your own analysis on large datasets, and you've caught a system or report that was wrong.

- E-commerce or marketplace fulfilment experience, such as restock and capacity limits, storage fees and returns. Amazon FBA experience is a strong plus.

- Fluent written and spoken English, good enough to negotiate with suppliers and push back on management.



WHAT D
 BETWEEN GOOD CANDIDATES

- You take initiative without waiting for the work to be laid out for you

- You've managed at least one direct report. Coordinating peers doesn't count.

- You can work well without a mature ERP or documented processes, and you build what's missing

- You push back on management when you disagree, and you back it up with numbers



NICE TO HAVE

- Lean, Six Sigma or similar process improvement work with measured results

- Experience with EU product compliance such as CE marking and product documentation

- Experience building a supply chain from scratch, not just running one that already existed



THIS ROLE IS PROBABLY NOT A FIT IF

- Your experience is mainly general VA work, admin or listing management

- You've only worked in B2B, retail or manufacturing distribution, with no e-commerce

- You've carried out replenishment but never set the parameters behind it

- Freight forwarders have always handled imports for you with nobody checking their work



HOW TO APPLY

Fill out our application form and upload your resume here:

👉

title: YouTube Channel Manager — Faceless Channels — Freelance, Remote
description:
I run a portfolio of faceless YouTube channels from the Netherlands with a remote team of scriptwriters, video editors and thumbnail artists. I'm looking for one person to become my right hand on the operational side.



Start date, hours and salary



Starting 1 October 2026. You begin at around 12 hours a week while you learn the channel and the pipeline. As you take on more — and as we add channels — that grows toward full-time, up to 40 hours a week. How fast depends on you. Pay is negotiable, and grows as your responsibilities do.



How this grows



You start with one channel — BloopUniverse, in the celebrity bloopers and compilations niche — and you run it end to end. Once it's running smoothly, we add a second channel built on AI scripts and voiceover. Then a third, and so on. The portfolio is expanding, and I need someone who grows with it rather than someone I have to replace when it does. Your rate goes up as the scope does.



So the first months are about BloopUniverse, done properly. The long game is that you manage several channels, each with its own team.



Working with AI is a requirement, not a bonus



Read this part carefully, because it's the core of the job.



For my other channels I've built AI agents that produce first drafts of scripts and thumbnail concepts. You paste in the title and references, and the agent gives you something back. That part is easy. What I'm hiring for is everything after: judging what came out, rewriting it, sharpening it, and rejecting it when it isn't good enough.



Daily work with Claude and ChatGPT is non-negotiable. If you're not already using these tools every day and getting real results out of them, this role isn't for you. But if you know why one prompt lands and another doesn't, and you can spot mediocre AI output in three seconds, you'll do well here.



Week to week



Brief and chase our scriptwriters, editors and thumbnail artists — deadlines, feedback, revisions

Upload and schedule: titles, descriptions, tags, thumbnails, end screens, playlists

Keep the content calendar current so nobody is waiting on anyone

Report weekly on views, CTR and retention — and tell me what you think it means

Write and publish community posts

Run the AI agents for scripts and thumbnails, then rewrite, sharpen and reject until the output is genuinely good (at a later stage)

And more — curious? Ask me for the full task list

title: Operations Manager
description:
The Operations Manager runs the operational backbone of the business and acts as the Management Representative for our Integrated Management System. You will keep day-to-day operations running smoothly and compliantly — procurement, supplier, asset and access management, business continuity, document control and cross-department coordination across our UK and Philippines teams — while owning the QMS, ISMS and AIMS: maintaining them, keeping them audit-ready, running internal audits and management reviews, and driving continual improvement. You will also run the quarterly project cadence that keeps every department's projects on track. It is a hands-on governance and operations leadership role reporting directly to the Managing Director, with scope to build an Operations Assistant function and automate recurring work.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Integrated Management System & governance (Management Representative)

• Establish, maintain and continually improve the IMS across ISO 9001, ISO 27001 and ISO 42001, and report its performance to top management.

• Own the internal audit programme end-to-end — plan, schedule, conduct or coordinate audits, log findings and drive them to closure; act as primary liaison with BSI and external/certification auditors.

• Organise and facilitate management reviews; capture minutes, decisions and actions.

• Run document control: the controlled-document register, version control, scheduled reviews and approvals.

• Coordinate nonconformity and corrective/preventive action (NC/CAPA) across all three systems, tracking each to closure.

• Own the integrated risk & opportunity process: maintain the register, facilitate assessments,

drive treatments and recommend residual-risk acceptance to the Managing Director.

• Steward the scope, Statement of Applicability, policies and objectives, keeping them current.



Project & portfolio governance

• Run the quarterly project cadence across the business — review each department's projects to ensure they are running as planned, on scope and on schedule.

• Maintain the project tracker; surface slippage, risks, blockers and dependencies, and hold owners to their commitments.

• Report project status and portfolio health to the Managing Director, and keep BAU (run) work and project (change) work clearly separated.



Compliance, information security & risk

• Administer information-security operations: asset inventory, access identities and periodic user-access reviews, supplier/third-party security management, BYOD compliance, i
 logging and coordination, and change management.

• Maintain the legal, regulatory and contractual requirements register and coordinate operational compliance (UK GDPR/data protection, sector and AI-governance obligations).

• Own business-continuity and disaster-recovery readiness — plans, drills and tests.



Operations & resource management

• Run the procurement and purchasing process, including supplier onboarding and due diligence.

• Coordinate cross-department alignment – weekly scoreboards and accountability, townhall inputs and BAU governance.

• Manage company tooling and the asset lifecycle; support operational budgeting.



People & culture (in partnership with HR)

• Support HR on onboarding/offboarding, the recruitment pipeline, the training & competence framework, the PDP cycle and rota/payroll oversight (HR owns execution).

• Champion an accountability culture across the UK and Philippines teams, and maintain the competence & awareness (training) matrix.



Performance, reporting & continual improvement

• Own monitoring and measurement – KPIs, scoreboards and performance evaluation – and report to leadership.

• Drive continual improvement and manage organisational change.



Leadership, delegation & automation

• Line-manage the operations and people-support functions; delegate effectively, and build and develop an Operations Assistant role.

• Use work-management tooling (
) and AI-enabled automation to streamline recurring governance and BAU work.





QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE & TRACK RECORD

We are hiring for experience. What you have actually run matters far more to us than the certificates you hold — a strong operator who has genuinely owned a live management system will always beat a certificate on its own. You should be able to point to concrete examples for most of the below.

• 5+ years in operations, quality or business-management roles, including at least 2 years managing people or running a function.

• Hands-on experience owning or running a live, ISO-certified management system in day-to-day operation — ISO 9001 and/or ISO 27001 (ISO 42001 a plus). This means having actually maintained it — document control, internal audits, management reviews, corrective actions and risk — not simply holding a certificate.

• Direct experience of external certification audits — preparing for and being audited by a certification body (e.g. BSI or similar) and taking findings and nonconformities through to closure.

• Proven experience running internal audits (ISO 19011 principles) and managing NC/CAPA and a risk & opportunity register.

• Experience running a regular project review or cadence and keeping delivery on track across multiple teams or departments.

• Practical experience of information-security governance operations — access reviews, asset management, supplier/third-party risk, i
 handling and business continuity.

• Experience of document control / management-system administration.

• Experience coordinating distributed or offshore teams (e.g. UK and Philippines) and working across time zones.

• Hands-on with 
 or a comparable work-management platform, and comfortable using automation or AI to reduce manual work.

• Experience line-managing, delegating and building out a team or an assistant function.

• Sound data-protection / UK GDPR awareness and the discretion to handle confidential security, HR and commercial information.

• Excellent English communication and stakeholder management at all levels, including with senior leadership and external auditors.

• Highly organised and self-directed — able to manage many concurrent recurring obligations to deadline with minimal supervision.

We prioritise proven experience over formal qualifications. A relevant degree (business, operations, quality or information management) is welcome but not essential, and ISO / audit certifications are a nice-to-have rather than a prerequisite — we will happily consider candidates whose hands-on track record demonstrates the same capability.



DESIRABLE/NICE TO HAVE (not required)

None of the below is essential — they are advantages. Where a certification is listed, equivalent hands-on experience is valued just as highly.

• ISO 27001 and/or ISO 9001 Lead Auditor or Internal Auditor certification – a bonus, not a prerequisite.

• A project-management qualification or method (e.g. PRINCE2, Agile) or a comparable delivery track record.

• ISO 42001/AI-governance exposure.

• Cyber Essentials familiarity; a data-protection qualification (e.g. GDPR Practitioner, CIPP/E).

• Procurement/vendor-management experience.

• Continual-improvement methods (Lean, Six Sigma) or change-management exposure.

• Experience in a SaaS or technology business.



If you’re ready to be a part of a team and are eager to pursue a path of continuous learning and career growth, we encourage you to apply and join us. Send your CV to

title: Sales Caller (Full Time, Hourly Plus Commission)
description:
Remote. US hours.



What we do

OEP is a business broker firm in Chicago. We represent owners of small and mid sized service businesses (landscaping, roofing, HVAC, plumbing, electrical) when they d
 to sell. Most of these owners are 50 to 70 years old, have run the business for decades, and have had people reaching out to them in the past about an exit. We find them, walk them through what their business is worth, and run the sale to a funded buyer. Usually off-market buyers. 



What the job is

You are on the phone all day talking to business owners. Plus follow-up
, HubSpot reminders, etc. All of this will have the goal of scheduling a call with them and the owner of OEP. You will also send NDAs, follow-up on unsigned NDAs, send document request lists. 



Two sources of calls:

1. Inbound and warm. We have a high-volume
 campaign running that will send 40k
s a month, that should produce 50+ warm leads per month. 

When someone raises a hand, you call them, qualify them, and book the evaluation call. Speed matters. 



The ones we reach in ten minutes convert at a completely different rate than the ones we reach the next day.



2. Cold call, when #1 has no tasks remaining for the day. Owners in this world answer their own phones early and late in the day. You will be dialing before and after the standard workday, because that is when you reach them.



You also own follow up. Most of these owners are not selling this month. They are selling in a year or two. That means a real cadence of calls and check ins over months, tracked in HubSpot, so that when they are ready we are the call they make. If you think of follow up as busywork between fresh leads, this is not the job.



Pay

$12-16 an hour base, depending on experience. Commission on top, paid on closed sales could EASILY exceed $50k / year. A top performer could make $100K+ all in. 



Requirements

A documented B2B sales history where you were the one closing or booking, and you can tell us your numbers. Genuinely strong phone skills, meaning you can hold a conversation with a 62 year old owner who is skeptical, busy, and not sure he wants to talk. Comfort with high volume dialing. 



Discipline to log everything in the CRM without being chased. Availability outside 9 to 5, when needed.



What we are not looking for

-Someone who needs a script read to them word for word. Someone who only works the easy leads. Someone who goes quiet when a week is slow.



How to apply

Send your resume and a 60 second voice recording. In the recording, tell us the hardest sale you ever made and what you said to get it. We listen to every one of these before we read a resume.

title: Wave Bookkeeper Needed for 2026 Setup and Monthly Amazon/Stripe Reconciliation
description:
We are looking for an experienced Wave bookkeeper to set up new, clean books beginning January 1, 2026 and provide ongoing monthly income reconciliation.



I will handle the ongoing expense categorization and provide the beginning balances. I need someone who understands Wave and can ensure that income from Amazon, Stripe, and any other payment platforms is recorded and reconciled correctly.



This will begin as an hourly project, with the possibility of ongoing monthly work.

Initial setup:

Create and configure new 2026 books in Wave

Set up an appropriate chart of accounts

Enter the January 1, 2026 beginning balances provided by me

Confirm that the opening balances tie back to the prior books

Connect or configure the applicable bank, credit card, and payment-platform accounts

Establish a consistent monthly reconciliation process



Monthly responsibilities:

Reconcile bank and credit card accounts

Reconcile Amazon Seller Central settlements

Reconcile Stripe activity

Reconcile any other payment processors or sources of income

Record gross sales, refunds, fees, reimbursements, chargebacks, and net deposits separately and correctly

Confirm that the amounts deposited into the bank match the related processor settlements

Maintain a monthly reconciliation of gross payment activity so the annual books can be matched to Amazon, Stripe, and other 1099-K forms

Identify missing, duplicated, or incorrectly recorded transactions

Provide a monthly list of discrepancies or questions for me to resolve

Keep the books organized and ready for year-end review by our CPA



I will manage most transaction categorization. This position is primarily focused on proper setup, reconciliations, income reporting, and ensuring the books accurately support the year-end tax documents.



Required experience:

Strong hands-on experience with Wave Accounting

Experience creating new books and entering opening balances

Experience reconciling Amazon Seller Central settlements

Experience reconciling Stripe and other payment processors

Understanding of gross payment activity versus net bank deposits

Familiarity with 1099-K reporting and reconciling the books to payment-processor totals

Strong knowledge of U.S. bookkeeping practices



Please answer these questions when applying:

1. How many businesses have you managed using Wave?
