Role Overview



An established electrical contracting business is hiring a part-time Virtual Assistant to take on operations and administration, freeing up the two directors to focus on running and growing the business. This is an operations-and-administration-first role, not a marketing-led one — while some light social media scheduling is included, content strategy sits with an external specialist, and the primary focus here is admin, job management, SOP-building, and lead/follow-up coordination.



The business has consciously stayed lean and is now focused on becoming a fully documented, less founder-dependent operation. Candidates with experience using GoHighLevel — particularly for lead pipelines, automated follow-up sequences, and CRM-style workflows — will be prioritised, as this kind of automation and pipeline thinking is directly relevant to the role's lead follow-up and customer communication responsibilities.



The role starts at 20 hours per week (4 hours/day, Monday to Friday) and both directors expect this could grow to full-time reasonably quickly as more responsibilities are handed over.

Store and link all SOPs in a system accessible via mobile, so field-based staff can reference them

Support customer communication throughout the job lifecycle, from initial enquiry through to job completion and follow-up

Manage customer comms within the job management platform where possible



Social Media & Website (Scheduling-Level, Not Strategist-Level)



Content strategy and creative are handled by an external content specialist. The VA's role is to receive approved content and manage scheduling and light repurposing (e.g. turning one video into a carousel or still-image post) across Instagram,
, and LinkedIn, not to originate strategy

Send an end-of-day report covering: tasks completed, work in progress, and items requiring attention or approval

Manage the task board across daily, weekly, and monthly cadences across all workstreams

Record training calls and use those recordings plus AI tools to generate SOP drafts

Participate in regular video calls, including impromptu calls while a director is on the road



What We're Looking For



Experience



Strong general business administration or EA background is the priority; social media experience is valued, trades or construction industry exposure strongly preferred

, Teams video, and associated tools

title: Part-Time X (Twitter) Community Manager — Pokémon TCG & Collectibles ($750–$1,000/mo)
description:
We run a collectibles and deals brand and are turning our X account into a page Pokémon collectors follow for timely release news and good conversation. We're hiring one person to run it day to day: track news, post, and — most importantly — spend the shift in real conversations with collectors.



This is a conversation-first job. Posting volume alone isn't the goal. We care about useful visibility, replies from real collectors, profile visits, and follows from the right people.



What you'll do



Stay ahead of the news. Follow official Pokémon accounts, retailers (Pokémon Center, Target, Walmart, Best Buy, GameStop, Costco), trusted collectible news accounts, and active collectors. Catch new sets, product reveals, preorder windows, release dates, and restocks.

Explain why it matters. Don't just repost. Say what's new, why it's interesting, and what people need to know — dates, times, time zones, and retailers once confirmed.

Join conversations all shift. Search relevant topics and reply with useful info, a specific opinion, or a question that moves the thread forward. No "Huge" / "That's crazy" replies.

Engage outside our page. Big accounts and small collectors alike. Be early. No link-dropping or "follow us" in other people's threads.

Quote-post with perspective. What an announcement means, an overlooked detail, or something specific to discuss.

Start collector discussions. Specific questions people have opinions on: best artwork in a set, which upcoming release they're most excited for, what Pokémon should bring back.

Build anticipation around releases. Reveal → confirmed details → reminders → launch-day updates. Each post adds new info. Correct anything that changes.

Verify before posting. Original sources first. Label rumors and leaks clearly. No "sold out everywhere" or "guaranteed to go up" claims without evidence.

Use visuals and give credit. Product images, card art, announcements. Credit sources and quote-post when building on someone else's reporting.

Keep replies active. Answer questions, follow up when details emerge. No arguments, console wars, or dunking on collectors for their preferences.

Report back. A short recap of what worked, what collectors are talking about, and upcoming releases we should cover.



Voice



Short, direct, informed, conversational. Sounds like someone who follows the hobby. No corporate wording, forced slang, hype, or repetitive openers.



You should have



Real Pokémon TCG knowledge — you already follow sets, artists, and release cycles

Strong written English

Availability during US hours (Eastern), when most drops and announcements land

Comfort with X search, quote posts, and threads

Your own active X account we can look at



Pay & hours



$750–$1,000/month depending on experience and hours



Monthly, long-term if it works



How to apply



Link your X account.

Write 5 replies to real Pokémon TCG posts from the last 24 hours (paste the post links and your replies).

Write 1 quote post for a recent announcement.

One or two sentences: which upcoming release are you most excited about, and why?

title: Creative Strategist – Meta Ads | E-commerce
description:
Creative Strategist

E-commerce · Meta Ads · Dropshipping & Branded Funnels

Part-time ? Full-time | NO · DE · CA · IL



About Us



If you've built winning Meta creatives for European e-commerce markets and you're tired of working with teams that don't move fast — this is for you.



We run a fast-growing e-commerce group with multiple dropshipping and branded funnels across Norway, Germany, Sweden, and Israel. Our products span health supplements, gadgets, and home goods — and we scale aggressively through paid Meta ads, high-volume creative testing, and data-driven decision making.



Our team includes media buyers, funnel builders, video editors, and customer support. We manage significant monthly ad spend across five active storefronts. Now we're hiring a Creative Strategist to own and systemise everything related to ad creatives.



The Role



You own the strategy behind all paid ad creatives. You don't edit videos or launch ads. Your job is to d
 what gets made, which angles get tested, why something wins or loses, and how winners are iterated and scaled.



You will work directly with the CEO, media buyers, and video editors with one goal: lower CPA and unlock scale.



What You'll Do

- Develop creative angles and concepts for Meta ads across multiple funnels and markets.

- Write clear, detailed creative briefs for video editors and UGC creators.

- Translate ad performance data (hook rate, CTR, CVR, ROAS, CPA) into actionable creative decisions.

- Define weekly creative testing priorities and iteration roadmaps.

- Analyse hooks, retention, watch time, scroll-stop rate, and creative fatigue.

- D
 when to iterate, kill, or scale creatives — and explain why.

- Ensure strong alignment between ads and landing pages across markets.

- Manage multi-market creative output — including copy adapted for NO, DE, SE, and IL audiences.

- Collaborate with media buyers to improve CPA stability and scalability.

- Maintain structured creative documentation and testing learnings.



What You Bring

- 2+ years of hands-on experience with performance creatives for Meta 
/Instagram) ads in e-commerce.

- Strong direct response mindset — you care about results, not aesthetics.

- Deep understanding of hooks, angles, retention curves, and creative testing frameworks.

- Ability to read ad performance data and turn it into clear, fast creative direction.

- Experience briefing and managing video editors or UGC creators.

- Fluent written and spoken English. Additional languages (Norwegian, German, Hebrew) are a plus.

- High attention to detail and a structured, systematic way of thinking.

- Ownership mentality — you spot problems early and act without hand-holding.

- Comfortable working with performance reports and creative trackers.



Experience with health/supplement creatives and Meta compliance is a strong advantage.



How We Work — and What You Get

- Part-time start with a clear path to full-time for top performers.

- $6–$10/hour depending on experience, with performance bonuses on top.

- Merit-based raises as your impact on ROAS and CPA becomes measurable.

- Direct collaboration with the CEO and media buyers — no layers, fast feedback.

- Access to proven funnels, live ad accounts, SOPs, and real ad spend from day one.

- Long-term growth into Head of Creative or broader strategy roles.

- Approved expense reimbursement where applicable.





How to Apply



Put your favourite animal in the subject line. This helps us spot detail-oriented applicants.



Please include:

- Your CV or resume

- Examples of creatives or brands you've worked on (screenshots or Looms are fine)

- A short paragraph on how you approach creative testing and iteration

- Your weekly availability

- Your approximate hourly rate expectation



Do not use AI to write your application. We test this during the assessment and will disqualify candidates who do.



We look forward to seeing what you've built.

title: Full-Time Real Estate Video Editor
description:
Full-Time Real Estate Video Editor

Remote | Philippines | Long-Term Role



We’re an Australian media company looking for an experienced full-time Real Estate Video Editor to join our team long-term.



This is not an entry-level editing role.



Your main responsibility will be editing high-quality real estate and property videos for our clients across Australia.



We produce everything from standard residential property videos through to premium homes, architectural properties, accommodation content and high-end cinematic property films.



We’re looking for someone who already has strong editing fundamentals, excellent creative judgement and a fast, reliable workflow.



WHAT YOU’LL BE EDITING



You’ll work on:

- Residential real estate videos

- High-end property videos

- Architectural property content

- Airbnb / accommodation videos

- Vertical reels

- Agent-presented videos

- Drone footage

- Lifestyle/property content

- Twilight and day-to-night property content where required



Most footage is shot professionally on Sony cameras in S-Log3, along with DJI drone footage.



WHAT WE EXPECT



A great property video is more than putting clips over music.



You need to understand:

- Storytelling

- Pacing

- Music selection

- Shot selection

- Strong opening hooks

- Flow through a property

- High-end cinematic editing

- Natural colour grading

- Sony S-Log3 footage

- Drone footage

- Speed ramping where appropriate

- Sound design

- Audio mixing

- Agent dialogue

- Captions and titles

- Vertical 9:16 editing

- 16:9 property videos

- Clean transitions

- Consistency across multiple jobs



We do not want excessive effects, transitions or trendy edits just for the sake of it.



Good taste and restraint are important.



SOFTWARE



You should be highly experienced with:

- Adobe Premiere Pro

- After Effects where required

- Adobe Media Encoder

- Professional colour grading workflows



SPEED, VOLUME & TURNAROUND



Quick turnaround is extremely important to us.



As a benchmark, our current in-house editors can complete a standard residential property video in approximately 1.5 hours on average.



More complex, premium or agent-presented edits may take longer, but for a standard property edit we expect you to be able to work at a similar pace once you understand our workflow and style.



If you do not believe you can realistically edit a standard property video to a high professional standard in around 1.5 hours, please do not apply.



We are not looking for someone who rushes and sacrifices quality.



We’re looking for an experienced editor who has built an efficient workflow and can produce consistently strong work quickly.



You may have multiple properties to edit in the same shift, so you must be comfortable:

- Managing several projects

- Working to tight deadlines

- Turning around edits quickly

- Prioritising urgent jobs

- Making amendments promptly

- Maintaining quality when volume increases



Reliability is critical because our clients work to property listing deadlines.



WORKING WITH OUR TEAM



You’ll work remotely with our Australian production team.



You’ll receive:

- Footage

- Job briefs

- Client requirements

- Reference edits where required

- Music direction where applicable



Over time, we expect you to learn our editing style well enough that you need less direction.



We want someone who thinks and makes good decisions, not someone who needs step-by-step instructions for every edit.



AMENDMENTS



Client amendments are a normal part of the role.



You need to be comfortable receiving feedback and making changes quickly.



We want someone who:

- Takes feedback professionally

- Pays attention to detail

- Fixes issues properly

- Can turn around amendments quickly



WHO THIS ROLE WOULD SUIT



You’ll likely be a strong fit if you:

- Already edit real estate/property videos professionally

- Have strong creative judgement

- Understand premium/cinematic editing

- Work quickly without losing quality

- Can work independently

- Communicate clearly

- Meet deadlines consistently

- Have reliable high-speed internet

- Have a computer capable of handling 4K footage comfortably

- Are organised when handling multiple jobs

- Want a stable long-term role



PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF



- You are still learning Premiere Pro

- Your portfolio is mostly basic template editing

- You rely heavily on pre-made transitions

- You need constant step-by-step direction

- You regularly miss deadlines

- Your computer struggles with 4K footage

- You are overloaded with other clients

- You cannot realistically complete a standard property video in around 1.5 hours



We’d rather hire one excellent editor than several average editors.



APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS



Please include:



1. Your Portfolio

Send your 3 best real estate/property videos.



Please do not send 20 links. Choose the three that best show the quality you can personally produce.



2. Your Experience

- How many years you have been editing professionally

- How much real estate/property editing experience you have

- Your experience with Sony S-Log3 footage

- Your experience with Premiere Pro

- Your experience with After Effects



3. Your Editing Speed



Please answer:



Approximately how long does it currently take you to edit a standard 60–90 second residential real estate video from organised footage?



Our in-house benchmark is around 1.5 hours per standard property edit.



Please answer honestly.



4. Your Computer Setup

- CPU

- GPU

- RAM

- Storage setup

- Internet download speed

- Internet upload speed



5. Availability

- Where in the Philippines you are based

- Your preferred working hours

- Whether you currently work with other clients

- Whether you are genuinely available for a full-time role



6. Salary Expectation



Please provide your expected monthly salary in PHP for a full-time position.



7. Application Question



At the end of your application, answer:



What do you think separates an average real estate video edit from an excellent one?



Applications that do not answer this question may not be considered.



EDITING TEST



Shortlisted applicants will be required to complete a practical real estate video editing test using footage supplied by NB Media.



We will assess:

- Storytelling

- Pacing

- Music selection

- Shot selection

- Colour grading

- Sound design

- Transitions

- Attention to detail

- Ability to follow a brief

- Creative judgement

- Editing speed



You will also be required to tell us exactly how long the edit took you.



Applicants who successfully pass the first stage will then be required to provide a screen recording of a full edit, showing your complete editing workflow from the supplied footage through to the finished video.



The screen recording helps us confirm:

- The work is genuinely your own

- How you approach an edit

- How efficient your workflow is

- How you make decisions during the editing process



ROLE DETAILS



Company: NB Media

Location: Remote – Philippines

Position: Full-Time Real Estate Video Editor

Industry: Media / Real Estate / Property Marketing

Employment: Full-Time, Long-Term



We’re looking for someone who can become a reliable long-term part of our production team.



If you’re a fast, experienced property editor with strong creative judgement and can consistently produce excellent work under tight deadlines, we’d like to hear from you.

title: FULL-TIME VIDEO EDITOR
description:
The role

You are the person who takes raw footage and turns it into scroll-stopping content. Every day, you will receive raw video clips from our shop floor (printing presses running, orders being made, finished products) and talking-head recordings from the owner. Your job is to edit these into short-form and long-form videos optimized for each platform.



This is a high-volume role. You will produce 8–15 edited video pieces per day across different formats. Speed, consistency, and understanding of what makes content perform on social media are essential.



What you will do

Short-form video editing (primary focus — 70% of time)

• Edit raw clips into 15–60 second videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts

• Add captions/subtitles to all videos (burned-in, styled, readable)

• Write and add text hooks in the first 1–2 seconds of every video

• Add transitions, zoom effects, and pacing that match platform trends

• Select and sync trending audio/music where appropriate

• Create satisfying loop videos from production process footage (press pulls, ink shots, transfer peels)

• Edit before/after reveal videos with dramatic transitions

• Format and resize the same video for different platforms (9:16, 1:1, 16:9)



Long-form video editing (20% of time)

• Edit 1 long-form YouTube video per week (5–15 minutes)

• Full process walkthroughs: a single order from design to shipping

• Educational content: print method comparisons, branding guides, industry tips

• Add intro/outro, lower thirds, chapter markers, and b-roll where needed

• Create compelling thumbnails for YouTube videos



Ad creative (10% of time)

• Edit short video ads for Meta 
/Instagram) campaigns

• Create multiple variations of the same ad for A/B testing

• Follow direct creative briefs from the Content Manager



Daily output expectations

• 8–10 short-form videos (TikTok/Reels/Shorts format) per day

• 2–3 Stories-format clips per day

• 1 long-form YouTube video per week

• 1–2 ad creatives per week



Requirements

Must have

• 2+ years of experience editing short-form video content (TikTok, Reels, Shorts)

• Portfolio/reel showing at least 10 short-form videos you’ve edited

• Proficient in CapCut Pro, Adobe Premiere Pro, or DaVinci Resolve

• Strong understanding of hooks, pacing, captions, and trending formats

• Ability to turn around 8–10 short clips per day consistently

• Understanding of what makes content perform on each platform (TikTok vs Reels vs Shorts)

• Clean, professional editing style — not over-edited, not under-edited



Nice to have

• Experience editing content for product-based or service-based businesses

• YouTube long-form editing experience (chapters, b-roll, pacing)

• Motion graphics or animation skills (After Effects, Motion)

• Thumbnail design skills (Photoshop or Canva)

• Basic color correction and audio cleanup skills

• Familiarity with royalty-free music libraries and sound design



Recruitment Process:

I. Initial Interview

II. Activity Video (Applicant must complete the activity video)

III. Final Interview



NOTE: Previous applicant need NOT TO APPLY.
